verdict.rationale: PayPal Agentic Commerce lets merchants build agent-driven commerce workflows through the agent toolkit, the MCP server, and Store Sync, so asking whether those automations can be versioned, reviewed, and rolled back is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents no versioning, change review, or rollback of automations or agent workflows. The sandbox testing environment and npm package releases of the toolkit are adjacent features or developer building blocks, so they earn no credit.
